trigger: DELIVERY-411-009 improved intrinsic material but produced zero realistically feasible survivor. This micro-probe tests the final pre-escalation branch in NAMING_RECOVERY.md.
purpose: Test whether morpheme-grounded, more-opaque proper-name surfaces can preserve real semantic lineage while reducing mature lexical namespace crowding and personal-name failure.

generation_contract.question_to_answer: Can a small portfolio of implicit, morpheme-grounded proper-name constructions produce at least one intrinsically strong, non-personal, realistically feasible umbrella name?
generation_contract.biggest_unknown: whether implicit morphology improves name completeness and namespace survival without collapsing into fantasy, biotech, personal-name, or generic-tech surfaces
generation_contract.name_job_focus: long-term umbrella organization; stable, harmonious, reliable; meaning and identity quality outrank shortness; one word or concatenated proper name; Chinese-speaker pronunciation and recovery matter

construction_portfolio.purpose: recover a compact institution-capable surface from a semantically complete classical or scholarly prototype
test uncommon complete forms whose internal morphology carries the relation implicitly rather than as an obvious A+B compound
create a proper-name surface with explicit morpheme lineage and controlled phonetic recovery

changed_phonetic_portfolio.consonant_profile: hard word-final /kt/, /st/, /nt/, /s/ and medial /sp/, /kst/, /gl/; avoid the prior soft -via/-ara/-ora/-ia profile
changed_phonetic_portfolio.stress_profile: four initial-stress, two medial-stress, two final/alternating-stress probes
changed_phonetic_portfolio.length: two or three spoken syllables preferred; four only for a complete lexicalized form
changed_phonetic_portfolio.recovery_rule: reject likely person-name segmentation or more than one common dictation spelling

anti_collapse_checks: intrinsic disposition before any domain or identity query
generation_contract.stop_condition: Freeze at eight. Advance only names that survive the explicit post-filter. If reality produces zero realistically feasible survivor, stop silent generation and escalate the exact .com quality-budget boundary.
